units.source_text: 不久到达宇治山庄。

en.t: Before long, they arrived at the Uji mountain villa.

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：“可怜啊！

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "How pitiful!

units.source_text: 她的亡魂宿在这里，此刻定然看见我来到吧。

en.t: Her departed spirit dwells here; surely she can see me arriving now.

units.source_text: 我做此种周章狼狈之事，毕竟为谁？

en.t: For whose sake, after all, am I doing these flustered and desperate things?

units.source_text: 无非是为了她呀！”

en.t: It is for no one but her!"

units.source_text: 下车之后，为欲使浮舟休息，暂时离开了她。

en.t: After getting out of the carriage, he left Ukifune for a while so that she could rest.

units.source_text: 浮舟在车中时，想起母亲对她何等挂念，不胜悲叹。

en.t: While Ukifune was still in the carriage, she remembered how anxiously her mother must be worrying about her and was overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 但念如此艳丽的男子情深意密地和她共语，颇感心慰。

en.t: Yet, thinking that such a handsome man was speaking with her so tenderly and intimately, she felt some comfort.

units.source_text: 于是跟着下车。

en.t: So she followed him and got out.

units.source_text: 老尼姑命车子停靠在走廊边，然后下车。

en.t: The old nun had the carriage drawn up beside the veranda, and then got out.

units.source_text: 薰大将看见了，想道：“此处不是我久居之地，她何必考虑得如此周到！”

en.t: Seeing this, General Kaoru thought, "This is not a place where I will stay long; why need she be so considerate!"

units.source_text: 附近庄园里的许多人照例纷纷前来参见主人。

en.t: As usual, many people from the nearby estates came one after another to pay their respects to their lord.

units.source_text: 浮舟的食事由老尼姑办理。

en.t: The old nun took charge of Ukifune's meal.

units.source_text: 适才来时，一路上荆榛满目。

en.t: On the way here just now, brambles and thickets had filled the view.

units.source_text: 此刻进了山庄，便觉环境开朗，气象清幽。

en.t: But now that they had entered the villa, the surroundings seemed open and the atmosphere serene.

units.source_text: 新建屋宇设计周妥，室中可以欣赏水光山色。

en.t: The newly built rooms were carefully planned, and from inside one could enjoy the light on the water and the colors of the mountains.

units.source_text: 浮舟近几日来愁闷之情，此时皆得排遣。

en.t: The gloom that had weighed on Ukifune for the past several days was all dispelled for the moment.

units.source_text: 然而想起了今后此身不知将被如何处置，则又恐惧不安，无法自慰。

en.t: Yet when she thought that she did not know what would be done with her from now on, fear and unease returned, and she could not console herself.

units.source_text: 薰大将忙写信给京中的母亲及二公主。

en.t: General Kaoru hurriedly wrote letters to his mother in the capital and to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 信中言道：“此间佛寺内部装饰尚未完竣。

en.t: In the letter he wrote, "The interior decorations of the temple here are not yet finished.

units.source_text: 前日曾予指示。

en.t: I gave instructions about them the other day.

units.source_text: 今日吉日，故匆匆前来检阅。

en.t: Since today is an auspicious day, I came in haste to inspect them.

units.source_text: 近来心情烦恼，又想起这几天不宜出行，故今明两日将在此间斋戒。

en.t: Lately my mind has been troubled, and remembering that these days are unsuitable for travel, I shall observe purification here today and tomorrow.

units.source_text: 过后当即返京。”

en.t: After that, I will return to the capital at once."
